retrieval_contract.eligible_source: Exact independently pinned completed journal whose original owner is locally Verified, with full original part inventory, completion proof and proven custody origin.

retrieval_contract.wire: Signed sequential Range GETs require HTTP 206, exact Content-Length and Content-Range, exact intent/plan/root/origin metadata and one strong opaque ETag.
